heading: Regulations covering lists of records for disposal, procedure for disposal, and standards for reproduction
lead: The Archivist shall promulgate regulations, not inconsistent with this chapter, establishing—

tree.text: procedures for the compiling and submitting to the Archivist of lists and schedules of records proposed for disposal,
procedures for the disposal of records authorized for disposal, and
standards for the reproduction of records by photographic, microphotographic, or digital processes with a view to the disposal of the original records.

notes.text: Historical and Revision NotesBased on 44 U.S. Code, 1964 ed., § 367 (July 7, 1943, ch. 192, § 2, 57 Stat. 381; June 30, 1949, ch. 288, title I, § 104, 63 Stat. 381).
